Smt. K Sravani vs Sri. K.Srisailam on 4 July, 2024 
Author: P.Sree Sudha
Bench: P.Sree Sudha
 The Hon'Ble Smt.Justice P.Sree Sudha
Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petition No.136 of 2024
Order: 
This Transfer C.M.P is filed by the petitioner-wife against the respondent-husband to transfer F.C.O.P.No.17 of 2024 from the file of Family Court- cum-Senior Civil Judge Court, R.R.District at Shadnagar to the Judge, Senior Civil Judge Court at Kalwakurthy. 
2. It is stated by learned counsel for the petitioner that marriage of the petitioner and respondent was performed on 12.02.2023. It came to know that petitioner affected with cancer in September,
2023. It is further stated that respondent-husband dropped petitioner at her parents house and could not take care of her and he filed O.P for divorce vide F.C.O.P.No.17 of 2024 but petitioner intended to take steps for Restitution of Conjugal Rights vide F.C.O.P(SR) No.801 of 2022 and also filed M.C.No.105 of 2022. It was further contended that petitioner is financially week and suffering from Cancer and thus requested for transfer of Divorce O.P filed by her husband. 
3. It is contended by learned counsel for the respondent that on 12.07.2023 respondent took the petitioner to the Hospital then the petitioner left the hospital with her mother without intimating him. It was further stated that medical record also placed on record. 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner relied upon citation reported in "Anuradha Samir Vennangot vs. Mohandas Samir Vennangot" 1 in which it was held that:
"Wife suffering from life-threatening disease-pre existing obligation of husband to care for wife in sickness. 
It cannot be disputed that after marriage, law enjoins the corresponding duty on the husband to look after her comforts and not only to provide her food and clothes but to protect her from all calamities and to take care of her health and safety."
5. Admittedly, in this case petitioner is suffering with cancer and distance between both the Courts is nearly 20 kilometers and this Court is of the considered opinion that in respect of transfer of proceedings of a matrimonial dispute, the convenience of the wife is to be preferred over the convenience of husband, as held by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Rajani Kishor Paradeshi Vs. Kishore Babulal Paradeshi 2 and Sumita singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay and another 3. 
Smt. K Sravani vs Sri. K.Srisailam on 4 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186177920/
1 6. In view of above, this Court is of the opinion that sufficient grounds are made out on facts and in law to accept the plea of the petitioner-wife for transfer of F.C.O.P.No.17 of 2024 from the file of Family Court-cum- Senior Civil Judge Court, R.R.District at Shadnagar to the Judge, Senior Civil Judge Court at Kalwakurthy. 1 2015 (16) SCC 596 2 (2005) 12 SCC 237 3 AIR 2002 SC 396 7. In the result, Transfer C.M.P is allowed with a direction to transfer F.C.O.P.No.17 of 2024 from the file of Family Court-cum-Senior Civil Judge Court, R.R.District at Shadnagar to the Judge,
Senior Civil Judge Court at Kalwakurthy duly indexed within one month from the date of receipt of copy of this order. There shall be no order as to costs. 
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
__________________________ JUSTICE P.SREE SUDHA Date:04.07.2024 Bw Smt. K Sravani vs Sri. K.Srisailam on 4 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186177920/
